gist.summary: Gen adds an RFC 9728 Bearer `WWW-Authenticate` challenge to every 401 response, pointing to its existing `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource` endpoint on the request’s public origin. OAuth clients can discover the metadata URL without hardcoding it, including after an unauthenticated generation cache miss. A regression test checks the staging-origin URL.
